objectives.hint: Grandfather always says to listen to the spirits. I'll climb to the stone on top of the rock — maybe they will say something there.
I'll sit on the stone and breathe the silence — maybe it will show me the way.

chronicle.text: Kusakam grumbled about the old man and wondered why the spirits would not make him a shaman yet.
He wandered the silent canyon, looking for answers in a dead wind.
From the ridge he saw villagers being led away — and something deep inside told him to run to the village.

objectives.hint: Bandits are leading our people away! Back through the canyon to the village, fast.
I'll go down the street to the middle of the village — someone has to be there.

objectives.text: Defeat the bandit in the street
objectives.hint: A bandit is blocking the street. He won't let me pass without a fight.
I have to get home and see if Grandfather is alive.
Catch up with the bandits. Head toward the canyon and come out on the road in the desert.

chronicle.text: Bandits had raided the village and were taking everyone away.
A bandit stopped him in the middle of the village.
Kusakam beat the bandit and went looking for the old man.
He found the old man in his ruined house. The old man healed him with the last of his strength. Then the old man told him the bandits had stolen the relic — the key to everything.
Kusakam left the empty village, sworn to follow the bandits. But first, the canyon was calling him back.

objectives.hint: From the edge of the canyon, by the bridge, you can climb down to the desert road.

chronicle.text: Armoured and ready, Kusakam began the climb down into the desert.

objectives.text: Defeat the enemies on the road
objectives.hint: The bandits who took my caravan are still on the road. Mind them.

chronicle.text: Enemies blocked the road. Kusakam fought his way through.

objectives.hint: The bandits' trail runs along the road straight to the city gates.
Bandits at the gates! Help us hold them!
The gates are clear. Into the city.

chronicle.text: He reached the great city gates and found the way barred.
Bandits attacked the gates; he fought them off beside the guards.
Through the gates at last, they set out to find the laboratory.

objectives.hint: Bars, a cage, strange voices... I have to look around and see where they dragged me.
The bars are open. I'm going out before anyone comes back.

chronicle.text: He came to in a laboratory cell and watched a fire djinn tear its way out of a prisoner and burst through the ceiling.
The cells stood open. He met the others from the mayor's queue — and Malik, who swore gold to anyone who led him out.

objectives.hint: The way out is at the bottom, past three floors of guards. Lead on — I'm right behind you.
The mercenary wants Grandfather's cloak. I won't give it up — so we fight.
The mercenary is down and the gates are open. Out, to freedom.

chronicle.text: He fought his way up through three storeys of the laboratory's guards.
The master of the laboratory declared it the end of his road.
Kusakam defeated the boss, and the way out lay open.

objectives.hint: A few more steps and we are out in the open air.
We made it out. A hard road — but we made it.

chronicle.text: They stepped out of the laboratory into the open air. It was a hard journey — but they made it.
